workPackage.request: Worker performance evidence for #191, parent #118. Fixtures originate from #118/F03.
workPackage.dependencies: Existing staged office-dist and production Node 24.21.0; no build or UI.
workPackage.delivery: Six existing real fixtures, at least five fresh processes per fixture per pass, raw JSON and median/max/p95, byte counts and runtime memory.
workPackage.nonGoals: Product optimization, fixture generation, full builds, Tauri/application end-to-end measurements, publishing or review agents.
workPackage.acceptance: All inspect calls succeed; production staged worker and artifact hashes match; complete raw records and summaries saved to the requested output.
workPackage.verification: Node syntax check, execute benchmark, assert sample counts and statistics, diff check.

evidence.finding: Production validates canonical base64, serializes a frame, spawns a permission-restricted Node process with version guard and empty PATH; benchmark excludes Rust costs and uses the same Node arguments.
Buffers stdin through EOF, concatenates, UTF-8 decodes and JSON parses, imports runtime, JSON stringifies response and writes one frame.
Base64 decode then canonical re-encode precedes dynamic engine import and inspect. Diagnostic measures actual base64 calls and engine import/inspect; these are instrumented costs.

DOCX open applies ZIP budget gate, separately loads ZIP and decodes XML/rels for UTF-8 validation, then parseDocx; inspect returns full sourceBase64 as well as model. Not all validation passes are redundant; only total inspect is timed here.
PPTX validates opened XML, clones slides, builds renderSlides and serializes media plus full sourceBase64; payload measurements quantify model amplification, not renderer time.

XLSX starts native sidecar, writes source bytes to private temp file, opens workbook, performs bounded per-sheet range/formula/outline/media requests, then stops sidecar and removes temp data. Diagnostic records actual command round trips and sampled sidecar RSS; no cumulative child peak is inferred.
Native sidecar introduces a second JSON line protocol inside worker inspect; diagnostic records parse/stringify counts and command round trips including native work.

App inspect reads through project_file_read_office_source before worker and again after async completion for ownership/policy/source revalidation. Excluded from this worker benchmark; post-await integrity check is a required constraint, not an optimization recommendation.
